# Sparkle dependency

Sparkle 2.10.0, official release `https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/tag/2.10.0`, downloaded via HTTPS from `Sparkle-2.10.0.tar.xz`. GitHub release API reports archive SHA-256 `c2bf58aa8387266ac179357b1415d6f2635f044da8be41042af32425dae6da0c`, matching downloaded bytes. Archive includes the framework, signing tools and MIT license in this directory. The upstream framework's own signature is ad hoc; local strict/deep validation succeeded using the absolute path, so integrity attribution relies on the HTTPS GitHub release digest and pinned local inventory, not an upstream Developer ID signature. Distribution builds must explicitly re-sign nested code with the distribution identity. The app's LICENSE and this dependency's LICENSE are distinct and both must be distributed.
